baseline_models.focus_anchor: The whole construction قالوا إنا أرسلنا إلى قوم مجرمين joins overt speech, passive dispatch, directed motion, a human collective, and an agentive culpability label.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speakers vocalize their credential as released message-bearers moving toward a standing human collective; مجرمين identifies that collective by culpable action rather than mere misfortune.

activation_trace.role: Voiced saying makes the declaration an overt credential rather than an unspoken intention.
Release and dispatch supply the commissioned motion toward the named target.
The carried saying and its carrier fuse the present speech with the speakers' envoy role.
A human collectivity supplies the social scale at which the mission is framed.
Offense and perpetration make culpable agency the target-defining property.

changed_reading.before: A group simply reports that it was sent to criminals.
changed_reading.after: The report itself authenticates commissioned agents whose directed mission is keyed to the culpable agency of a whole collective.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural active description مجرمين modifies قوم and can be heard through both acquisition and offense branches of ج ر م.
baseline_models.mechanism: The target identity is causally acquired: acts accrue into liability, and that earned condition becomes the reason a social collective is addressed by the mission.

activation_trace.role: The people form the shared social bearer of the acquired designation.
Acquiring or causing acquisition supplies the arrow from repeated acts to accumulated liability.
Crime and transgression specify what the collective has acquired.
Dispatch answers the acquired condition with an externally initiated mission.

changed_reading.before: مجرمين is a static class label meaning wrongdoers.
changed_reading.after: مجرمين presents a community whose acts have accrued into the actionable liability that calls forth the dispatch.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The approach to قوم مجرمين permits the cutting and completed-time branches of ج ر م to coexist cautiously with its ordinary offense branch.
baseline_models.mechanism: Dispatch approaches a collective at a possible cutoff point: the order by which it stands has reached a term that can be severed, while culpability remains the controlling sense.

activation_trace.role: Release toward the target initiates the possible terminal transition.
That by which a thing stands supplies the collective order exposed to termination.
Cutting and severance image judgment as a decisive interruption.
A completed and elapsed term makes the interruption potentially terminal rather than merely punitive.

changed_reading.before: The agents have a mission to an already criminal destination.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the agents approach a culpable collective precisely as its sustaining term reaches a cutoff.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those first received as honored guests and classified by Abraham as an unrecognized قوم disclose themselves as commissioned carriers sent toward another قوم, now classified by culpability. The focus answer reverses who knows and who is being classified.

activation_trace.role: A traveler inclining down as a guest supplies the visitors' initially domestic role.
Honor and noble treatment frame the visitors positively before their severe commission is disclosed.
The first قوم supplies the same collective frame later used for the mission's destination.
Nonrecognition makes the visitors the initially classified and epistemically opaque group.
Naming them as message-carriers replaces the guest category with an envoy category.
The destination repeats the human-collective frame while transferring it to a new group.
Culpability replaces unfamiliarity as the decisive classificatory property.

structural_cues: قوم منكرون at 51:25 and قوم مجرمين at 51:32 repeat a noun-plus-participle frame.
The direct mission question in 51:31 is answered immediately by the focus ayah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a continuous plural visitor scene and the mirrored قوم phrases; I infer a deliberate role reversal from classified strangers to authoritative classifiers. The live alternative is ordinary lexical repetition without rhetorical force.

changed_reading.before: Unknown speakers identify a criminal destination.
changed_reading.after: The formerly unknown and honored guests reveal their envoy identity by classifying another people, turning the answer into a reversal of epistemic and social roles.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the mission question, the visitors relay a saying attributed to the sovereign, wise Lord; then they are addressed as envoys and answer with another saying. Their قالوا in the focus therefore carries an already established relay authority.

activation_trace.role: Two voiced sayings form an explicit relay from attributed source to visitor speech.
Sovereignty and lordship give the relayed saying its authority.
Exact ordering and firm execution qualify the authority behind the visitors' disclosures.
The envoy as carrier of a saying identifies the visitors as a transmission link.
Their audible answer continues the established relay rather than starting an isolated report.
Carried saying and commissioned carrier converge in the self-description أرسلنا.

structural_cues: 51:30 nests the visitors' saying around قال ربك.
51:31 names the speakers المرسلون before 51:32 gives their answer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the saying relay, sovereign attribution, envoy address, and focus answer; I infer that this established authority carries into the mission disclosure. A live alternative is that 51:30 authorizes only the birth announcement, not the judgment mission itself.

changed_reading.before: قالوا merely introduces the agents' own explanation.
changed_reading.after: قالوا is the next link in an authorized relay: recognized carriers now disclose the other side of their commission.

context_deltas.mechanism: The passive dispatch of agents إلى a people opens into their active purpose لنرسل a marked, solid clay payload عليهم. One sending contains another, converting a generic mission into a directed delivery chain.

activation_trace.role: The agents' release and dispatch form the upstream leg of the chain.
Culpable action supplies the reason the second sending is directed at this people.
A second active sending makes the dispatched agents initiators of a downstream dispatch.
Solid stone gives the downstream dispatch a concrete striking payload.
Mixed clay specifies the payload's worked material composition.
A visible identifying mark makes the material dispatch selected rather than indiscriminate.

structural_cues: أرسلنا in 51:32 is immediately answered by لنرسل in 51:33.
The direction changes from إلى قوم to عليهم while the same sending root is retained.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated sending root, purpose construction, changed prepositions, and marked material; I infer an upstream-agent to downstream-payload delivery chain. The agents could alternatively be direct executors rather than couriers, but the nested dispatch remains.

changed_reading.before: The agents were sent on an unspecified mission to a criminal people.
changed_reading.after: The agents were sent as the upstream operators of a second, targeted sending that delivers marked clay stones upon that people.

context_deltas.mechanism: The broad قوم is redescribed by exceeded limits, then opened spatially so trusting inhabitants can be brought out; the search resolves not to ethnic totality but to one submitting household. Judgment operates by conduct and extraction inside a population.

activation_trace.role: The people supply the outer social container whose internal composition remains to be tested.
Perpetrated offense defines the condemned relation within that container.
Exceeding a limit sharpens criminality into a threshold-crossing pattern of conduct.
Movement to the outside performs the separating operation before judgment.
Heart-settling assent marks those selected for extraction by a contrary relation.
A household and its people reduce the protected subset from collective scale to one domestic unit.
Safety from defect and harm supplies the countercondition to the criminal designation.

structural_cues: The marked payload is assigned to المسرفين rather than to an unqualified place.
51:35 extracts a plural class, while 51:36 finds only one qualifying house.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies conduct labels, outward extraction, and the one-house result; I infer that قوم is a jurisdictional population from which a protected subset is sorted before impact. The labels may denote overlapping virtues rather than a formal classification scheme, but selection is explicit.

changed_reading.before: A whole people is treated as an undifferentiated criminal bloc.
changed_reading.after: The people is the field of judgment, but مجرمين is conduct-defined and operationally selective: protected members are removed before the remaining collective is struck.

context_deltas.mechanism: The visitors first detect and cancel Abraham's fear while opening his face with good news; after their focus disclosure, the episode becomes a sign for people who fear painful punishment. The mission statement is the hinge that reallocates fear according to relation to the commission.

activation_trace.role: Expected harm first attaches fear to the visitors, then their speech explicitly blocks it.
News that opens the complexion with joy establishes the visitors' reassuring function.
The new utterance pivots from reassurance to disclosure of the severe commission.
Dispatch explains why the same visitors can remove fear here and ground it elsewhere.
Expected harm reappears as the fitting response of later witnesses to the judgment sign.
Punitive pain supplies the object to which fear is finally redirected.
Experienced hurt intensifies the feared consequence beyond abstract sanction.

structural_cues: The same plural visitors speak لا تخف before they speak the focus mission statement.
The pericope closes by naming those who fear the painful punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the two fear positions, glad news, mission disclosure, and closing sign; I infer that 51:32 redistributes rather than simply increases fear. The alternative is that the two fears serve unrelated local functions.

changed_reading.before: The focus answer neutrally states the visitors' destination.
changed_reading.after: The answer turns the visitors' presence from wrongly feared hospitality into a commission that properly grounds fear for culpable targets and later witnesses.

context_deltas.mechanism: The completed-term branch latent in مجرمين is activated by a selected mark before impact and a durable sign after it. Culpability is read not only as a condition but, cautiously, as a condition that has reached its designated closure.

activation_trace.role: Completion and temporal cutoff supply the otherwise latent terminal dimension of the target label.
An identifying mark makes the coming closure appear designated rather than accidental.
Leaving an effect converts the completed event into a persistent remainder.
A manifest sign makes the terminal event readable after its completion.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from mission disclosure to marked payload, extraction, and aftermath.
The final ayah explicitly preserves a sign inside the judged place.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ج ر م completion branch, pre-impact marking, and post-impact sign; I supply the arrow from designation to a judicially completed term. The materially live alternative is that مجرمين carries only its ordinary offense sense and the temporal echo is accidental.

changed_reading.before: The mission concerns people who possess an ongoing criminal quality.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it concerns culpability at its designated terminal point, when liability is closed into an event and then retained as a sign.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because مجرمين ordinarily denotes perpetrators, not harvest residue. It remains anchored in the packet's ج ر م cutting and post-harvest-remnant branches and in the explicit extraction-then-remainder sequence. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy subordinate to culpability, not as a lexical replacement.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The final word مجرمين can carry the packet's cutting and fallen-remnant images while still naming the culpable target.

activation_trace.role: Cutting or harvesting images the decisive removal applied to the culpable remainder.
What falls or remains after cutting supplies the residue image for those left after sorting.
Bringing the protected subset outside performs the sorting that creates a remainder.
Exception and exclusion isolate the single house from what otherwise remains.
An effect left behind completes the residue pattern at the level of aftermath.

changed_reading.before: مجرمين only labels the people as perpetrators.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, مجرمين also images the culpable population left after protective sorting as harvest residue destined for cutting, with a sign remaining afterward.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant ق ل ل mapping under the focus occurrence قالوا. It remains auditable through that supplied mapping and visibly joins speech to the visitors' movement and dispatch. It must be rendered as a phonological-root-network echo, never as a claim that قالوا lexically means they departed.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: At قالوا, the dominant saying branch and the mapped carrying, rising, and departing branch can briefly superimpose as the envoys state their commission.

activation_trace.role: Entering an interior establishes the visitors' arrival before their mission identity is known.
Actual voiced speech remains the controlling contribution of قالوا.
Carrying, rising, and setting out add a form-distant motion echo to the moment of disclosure.
Dispatch gives the motion echo a visible anchor in the stated commission.

changed_reading.before: Their saying merely reports a prior sending.
changed_reading.after: As a tightly qualified root-network echo, the utterance also performs a taking-up and setting-out: the visitors voice the charge at the point their guest role yields to dispatched motion.

strongest_changes: The mirrored قوم منكرون and قوم مجرمين frames turn the answer into a reversal from classified strangers to commissioned classifiers.
The immediate أرسلنا to لنرسل repetition nests the agents' dispatch inside a targeted dispatch of marked clay stones.
Extraction of believers and discovery of one submitting house revise قوم from an undifferentiated bloc into a selectively judged population.
The visitors' speech reallocates fear: it removes fear from the host, then grounds fear of painful punishment for culpable targets and later witnesses.
summary.what_was_special: A short mission answer becomes the pericope's conversion point: guests become envoys, relayed speech becomes material delivery, a collective label becomes a sorting operation, and ج ر م keeps legal, acquired, terminal, and residual images simultaneously available without collapsing them.
remaining_uncertainties: The rhetorical force of the two قوم-plus-participle phrases may exceed what lexical repetition alone warrants.
The completed-term and harvest-residue branches of ج ر م may be productive context activations or only distant echoes beneath the ordinary offense sense.
The Lord-saying relay clearly establishes authority, but its explicit saying in 51:30 concerns the birth announcement rather than directly stating the judgment commission.
The marked payload supports selection, but the packet does not specify whether marks identify individual targets, stones, timing, or assignment.
